title: pip-agents brief, version 1
description: A brief is the whole Agent prompt: one `key: value` line per field (VALIDATOR.md, 'Parsing a brief'), parsed into this object. Values are paths, line ranges, ids or short scalars, never pasted file text. Briefs are DATA the dispatcher writes; the persona's lens or task line says which optional fields it reads.

kind.description: must equal the dispatched persona's kind (tools.md)

ref.description: dispatcher correlation id (seat, batch, chunk); echoed in the result

target.description: what is examined: a diff file, a file-list file, or up to 20 space-separated paths

rules.description: <abs path> L<a>-<b>[,L<c>-<d>] [(<ids>)], or an id list; never #fragment

claims.description: path to claims: author text (review) or a JSON list of 1-10 {id, claim, where} (validate)

intent.description: path to what was approved: card, issue, plan or task text

tests.description: the one test command a Bash-bearing reviewer may run, verbatim

context.description: path to extra dispatcher facts (base ref, untrusted sources, env map)

question.description: locate: what to find, one sentence

names.description: locate: comma-separated symbols, modules or patterns; each gets a counts entry

run.description: run: the one command, no shell metacharacters

out.description: run: the file the command writes

counts.description: run: comma-separated top-level integer keys to read from out

bundle.description: plan/change/test: an overseer dispatch bundle path (adapters only)
